Aventon Ramblas ADV
Hardtail Electric Mountain Bike

 

The Aventon Ramblas ADV is a purpose-built hardtail eMTB that brings a strong mid-drive spec to trail riding without the full-suspension price tag. Aventon's A100 mid-drive motor delivers 100Nm of torque with a natural, terrain-synced power feel, and a 708Wh battery pushes range up to 90 miles. The RockShox Psylo Silver R coil fork with 35mm stanchions, rebound adjustment, and 15x110mm Boost spacing delivers a planted, confidence-inspiring front end. SRAM DB6 4-piston hydraulic disc brakes with 200mm rotors front and rear handle stopping duties, and a SRAM NX 12-speed drivetrain keeps shifting precise across the full 10-50T cassette. The Manic LC 150mm travel dropper seatpost is included and puts you in the right position for climbs and descents without stopping to adjust. The Ramblas ADV rolls on Maxxis Rekon 29"x2.4" tubeless-ready tires and ships as Class 1, adjustable to Class 3 via the Aventon MyRide app. No throttle is compatible. Available by special order at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL.

Integrated lights are included. Fenders and rear rack are compatible but not included and must be purchased separately. Note: 4G connectivity details follow Aventon's standard ACU platform terms - 4G is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period.

E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee

The Ramblas ADV is a special order item at Quest Watersports - we don't stock it on the floor, but we can get one for you. Lead time is typically 1-2 weeks subject to Aventon's inventory. Let us order one for you today - call 815.433.2200 or email contact@questwatersports.com.

Included with every Ramblas ADV:

  • Manic LC dropper seatpost - 150mm travel, 31.6mm, 395mm length
  • Integrated lights (front and rear)
  • Kickstand (in accessory box)
  • 9/16" alloy platform pedals
  • 42V 4A charger
 

Note: No throttle - not compatible. Fenders and rear rack are compatible but sold separately.
